patterns.message: Plugins may only use the top-level plugins-sdk surface (sdk.js, testHelpers.js from tests, leaf modules) — never plugins-sdk/internal/**. The full boundary is enforced by src/plugins-core/pluginBoundary.guard.test.ts.
Plugins must not import the plugin loader (src/plugins-core/**). Go through the plugins-sdk surface; if the SDK lacks the capability, grow it (src/plugins/CLAUDE.md).
